text: `--tag rc` is required for both: npm's default dist-tag is always `latest` regardless of the version string being a prerelease (npm does NOT auto-detect prerelease semver and skip `latest`), so omitting it would make `latest` point at 1.0.0-rc.1 on the very first publish. `--access public` is redundant since both package.json already set `publishConfig.access: "public"`, but it's a harmless explicit safety net for scoped packages.
